text:
sara-peopleops: Quick ping — interview for Senior Infra on Tue 3/16 10:00 PDT (60m). Panel: @alex, @nina, @jordan. Can you confirm availability and whether you need any accommodations? Zoom link: https://zoom.company/meeting/ABC123 (recording off by default). :wave:

alex-eng: I can do it. prefer camera on. I'll take System design.

nina-eng: available. I'll cover coding + microservice perf questions. note: we can't run remote code execution during the interview — please set expectations.

jordan-eng: I can make it but might be 5m late. I'll take behavioral/culture and ops/runbook questions.

maria-recruiter: Candidate is in PST, requested a 30min heads-up if schedule changes and mentioned a wheelchair-accessible room for on-site. Resume & interview packet: https://docs.company/candidates/infra-sr-210. Debrief template: https://docs.company/templates/debrief-infra.

sara-peopleops: two quick rubric clarifications: 1) scoring scale is 1-5; passing guidance is avg >= 3.5 but please *flag any blocking concerns* clearly in the 'concerns' field. 2) For system design, focus on trade-offs, scale estimations, and operational considerations — not on line-by-line code. If you disagree on a score, add short comments; we'll reconcile async.

alex-eng: where are the weightings recorded? I tend to weight design > coding for infra roles.

sara-peopleops: default weightings are in the debrief template (top-right): coding 40%, design 35%, behavioral 25%. Feel free to note a justification if you deviate.

nina-eng: ok. also can someone confirm the interview cadence/script? I usually run: '5m intros, 40m interview, 10m candidate q + recruiter wrap'.

jordan-eng: sounds good. if alex is late I can kick off intros.

interview-bot: Reminder scheduled — interview 2149001122 starting in 24 hours. Buffer room created: Zoom-Infra-1 booked for 70 minutes.

sara-peopleops: perfect. last ask: please take notes directly in the candidate debrief doc and paste bullets into the scoring form within 2 hours post-interview. If you have any accessibility needs, DM me. :thumbsup:
